--पुरूरवस् (s.v.) son of इऌअ: an इक्ष्वाकु and a राजऋषि;
1: वा. 2. २०; ३२, ४७: ५६. 1, 8, ९१.
family of.
2: Ib. ६१. ८६.
[page१-281+ ३२]
--a name for Kubera; the king of Paulastya राक्षसस्, यक्षस् and their sons and grandsons who were against Vedas and यज्ञस्। वा. ७०. ५४.
(I)--the son of दशरथ, and father of विश्वसह. भा.
